notes: Data drawn on the primary Y axis: any of "Temperature", "Wind", "Precipitation"; default c("Temperature").
Data drawn on the secondary Y axis; default c("Wind", "Precipitation").
"speed" (default) uses the wind speed column; "gust" uses the wind gust column for the wind line, the wind.ms cut-off, the buffer and wind.max.
Wind cut-off (m/s), default 4; "" = no wind cut-off.
Temperature cut-off (C), default 10; "" = no temperature cut-off.
Minutes in the monitoring window that wind may be at or above wind.ms before the night no longer counts (nights.auto). Default 10.
Minutes in the monitoring window that temperature may be at or below the temperature cut-off before the night no longer counts (nights.auto). Default 10.
TRUE: nights within the cut-offs in the monitoring window, apart from at most temperature.c_buffer / wind.ms_buffer minutes; FALSE: nights.manual (or all); "AND": both. Default TRUE.
Nights to plot, e.g. c("2026-06-25", "2026-06-27"); "" = all nights. Default "".
Nights (panels) per PNG, default 8.
Start of the monitoring window: clock time ("21:00") or minutes from Sunset/Sunrise ("-30 Sunset"). Default "-30 Sunset".
End of the monitoring window: length of time ("5 hours"), clock time ("01:00") or minutes from Sunset/Sunrise. Default "5 hours".
First time on the X axis, default "18:00".
Last time on the X axis, default "08:00".
Spacing of the Y-axis labels: heatmap2 / weather.daily default "1 hour"; plotsm4_heatmap minutes, default 60.

TRUE lines the temperature and wind axes up so temperature (10 C) is level with wind.ms (4 m/s), with the bottoms of the two axes level; the other axis is rescaled when temp.range or wind.range is changed. FALSE uses temp.range and wind.range exactly as given. Default TRUE.
Temperature axis limits, default c(0, 25).
Wind (and precipitation) axis limits, default c(0, 10).
FALSE (default): zero wind and zero precipitation are not drawn (temperature always is); wind.absent / precipitation.absent, when set, decide.
plot.zero for the wind line only: FALSE (default) = 0 not drawn; wins over plot.zero.
plot.zero for the precipitation bars only: FALSE (default) = 0 not drawn; wins over plot.zero.
"show" (default) draws zero-wind readings; "hide" leaves them out (wind line broken where there is no wind).
"hide" (default) draws no bar for zero precipitation; "show" draws zero precipitation as a blue line along 0, with zero wind drawn just above it when wind.absent = "show".
TRUE: precipitation is a running daily total and is turned into the amount per reading. Default TRUE.
Panels per row, default 2.
PNG width in inches, default 9.
